Raspberry Hood (Korean: ) is Bread Fairy's second Costume, released in the first half of the Camping with the Sanrio characters! update. It is a Rare Costume that can only be obtained by purchasing it with Acorn Medals in the Sanrio characters! Costume Shop.

Story

When making desserts, you have to wear a headscarf to keep things nice and clean! Angel Chiffon Cookie made a tiny hood just for Bread Fairy, who is so small that she used a little wild raspberry to make it. Seeing it so pleased makes all that wandering through the mountains in search of the perfect raspberry worth it!

Trivia

  • Raspberry Hood was released alongside  Kind Like My Melody,  Sweet Cake Barista,  Sweet Cake Slice,  Fluffy Like Cinnamoroll,  Cozy Guide,  Tart Parfait Barista,  Tart Cherry Cream,  Unpredictable Like Kuromi,  Purrfect Prankster,  Blueberry Yogurt Barista,  Blueberry Yogurt Cream,  Soft Pudding Barista,  Spoonful of Pudding,  Carefree like Pompompurin,  Caramel Syrup Beret,  Energetic Banana Bread Barista,  Banana Bread Bonnet,  Playful Like Pochacco,  Lucky Charm,  Hard Working Shaved Ice Barista,  Spoonful of Shaved Ice,  Warm Like Hangyodon,  Fish Cake Ribbon.
  • Raspberry Hood features Bread Fairy dressed in an outfit themed after My Melody Cookie.

Soft Strawberry Rice Cake (Korean: 딸기크림찹쌀떡, ttalgikeurimchapssalttok) is Bread Fairy's first Costume, released in the first half of The Great Pâtissier Battle update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Bread Fairy only ever intended to browse the strawberry festival's various desserts... but it got drawn in by delicious strawberry cream rice cakes, where it stuffed its cheeks until it was noticed by the festival-going Cookies! Now it's fluttering about, yelling about its baking greatness while dodging the hands of Cookies who think it is just another rice cake! Maybe it should just leave the rice cake corner...

Trivia

  • Soft Strawberry Rice Cake was released alongside  Strawberry Festival Mascot,  Conductor of Souls,  Fated Souls,  Performance from the Soul,  Grass Leaf Cafe and  Melon Bread Hat.
  • Soft Strawberry Rice Cake appears in  Strawberry Festival Mascot's gacha illustration.
